answer: Re-attestations are stored in fable and delta lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, which means holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the ripple graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1929 impostors cost 1281 times the honest price and take 21 times as long to clear.
